raw_typed_proposal.analysis_summary: Requested ORCA 6.1 sp with method.basis 'def2-ECP' reported as the only basis for Pd. The host lookup target 'basis: orca method.basis def2-ECP for sp' covers Pd (a def2-ECP entry exists for Pd), but that entry provides only the effective core potential (28 core electrons for the 4d series) and contains no orbital/valence basis functions: element finding for Pd is covered=true, orbital_present=false, ecp_present=true. An ECP-only definition cannot act as the sole Pd basis for an sp calculation because Pd would have no orbital functions in which to expand the wavefunction. The setting literal 'def2-ECP' is preserved as reported; the proposal is rejected as blocked_invalid_specification (ECP-only basis without orbital functions). No project written, no native input or ChemSmart command authored, no execution requested.
